question: What Are the Types of Power Distribution System Layouts?
body_html:
Power distribution system layouts are the arrangements of feeders, switchgear and transformers that carry power from the supply point to every load.

LayoutHow it works
RadialOne source; a feeder fault cuts all downstream loads
Parallel feederTwo feeders run side by side to the same load area for backup
Ring mainFeeders form a loop, so each substation is fed from two sides
InterconnectedSeveral sources and substations feed a meshed network

Radial is cheapest; ring and interconnected layouts keep power flowing when a section fails.
